pages.title: Beach Clean-Up Volunteer Sign-Up
pages.html:
🌊 Beach Clean-Up

Join Our Beach Clean-Up Event

Make a real difference in our community. Volunteer to help restore our beautiful coastline and protect marine life for generations to come.

Sign Up Now

About Our Clean-Up Mission

Every year, tons of plastic and debris find their way into our oceans, harming wildlife and damaging our coastal ecosystems. Our Beach Clean-Up initiative brings together passionate volunteers who want to take action and make a tangible impact.

This is more than just picking up trash—it's about building community, raising awareness, and showing our beaches the care they deserve. Whether you're an experienced volunteer or this is your first time, we have a role for you.

Event Details

📅 Date & Time

Saturday, June 15, 2025

7:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Registration begins at 6:30 AM

📍 Location

Crescent Bay Beach

1200 Coast Highway
Laguna Beach, CA 92651

View on Map

👥 What to Expect

  • Friendly team orientation
  • Assigned cleanup zones
  • All supplies provided
  • Free breakfast & refreshments
  • Certificate of participation

🎯 Our Goal

We aim to collect over 500 lbs of marine debris and engage 100+ volunteers from the community.

Last year, we removed 47 bags of trash and protected countless marine habitats.

Why Volunteer With Us?

Make an impact while building community connections and creating lasting memories.

🌍 Environmental Impact

Directly contribute to ocean conservation and habitat protection. Your efforts help reduce plastic pollution and keep our beaches pristine.

🤝 Build Community

Connect with like-minded individuals who care about our environment. Make new friends while making a difference together.

📜 Gain Experience

Perfect for students, job seekers, or anyone wanting to build volunteer experience and learn about marine conservation.

Volunteer Requirements

We welcome volunteers of all ages and abilities. Here's what you need to know.

✅ You Should Be Prepared To:

  • Arrive by 6:30 AM for check-in
  • Work for approximately 4–5 hours
  • Perform light to moderate physical activity
  • Follow safety guidelines
  • Wear closed-toe shoes and bring a hat

📋 What We Provide:

  • Safety gloves and grabber tools
  • T-shirt and visor
  • Breakfast and water
  • First aid support
  • Insurance coverage during the event

Age Policy: Volunteers under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. Group registrations are welcome!

Volunteer Sign-Up

Register below to secure your spot. We'll send you a confirmation email with final details.

What Our Volunteers Say

"This was an amazing experience! I met so many wonderful people who care about the environment. Seeing the difference we made in just one morning was incredibly rewarding."
— Sarah M., Teacher
"I brought my two kids and they loved it. The organizers were so welcoming and made everyone feel like they were making a real impact. We're definitely coming back!"
— James T., Parent
"As someone new to volunteering, I was nervous, but the team made me feel comfortable right away. Great way to give back to our community!"
— Maya C., College Student
"Our company participated as a team-building activity. It was fun, meaningful, and our employees left feeling proud and connected."
— Robert K., Business Owner

Frequently Asked Questions

Can't find the answer you're looking for? Contact us at info@beachcleanup.org

No experience necessary! We welcome volunteers of all skill levels, from first-timers to experienced cleanups coordinators. Our team will provide all the training and guidance you need.

We monitor weather closely and will send updates to all registered volunteers by 5:00 PM the day before the event. In case of severe weather, we'll reschedule to the following Saturday. Light rain won't cancel the event.

Absolutely! We encourage group participation. Each person must register individually, but you can list them as part of your group. Children under 18 must have a parent or guardian present and registered as well.

Yes, there is free parking in the Crescent Bay lot and adjacent street parking. We recommend arriving by 6:30 AM to secure a spot, as parking fills quickly. Carpooling is encouraged!

Wear comfortable, weather-appropriate clothing. Closed-toe shoes are required for safety. We recommend bringing a hat, sunscreen, and a light jacket. You'll receive a volunteer t-shirt and visor that you can keep!

We have roles for everyone! Let us know about any mobility concerns or limitations in the sign-up form, and we'll work with you to find a meaningful way to participate. We offer sorting, organizing, and other light-duty options.

Yes! All participants receive a certificate of participation at the end of the event. This is great for students, resumes, and school service requirements.

Your information is used only for event coordination and communication. We will not share your data with third parties. You'll receive updates about this event and future opportunities via email, and you can unsubscribe anytime.

© 2025 Coastal Community Beach Clean-Up. All rights reserved.

Contact: info@beachcleanup.org | Phone: (555) 234-5678
